image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a silver alloy car wheel mounted with a black rubber tire. The wheel features a five-spoke design with a central hub containing five lug nuts and a center cap. The tire shows visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The wheel is attached to a vehicle, with a portion of the silver car body and fender visible in the upper right. The ground surface appears to be a textured metal grid or grate.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for subtle fusion artifacts or bleeding between the tire rubber and the metal rim, a common AI failure mode.
To ensure the recessed nature of the hub and the thickness of the spokes are geometrically consistent and not flattened or warped.
To detect any low-level texture anomalies or noise inconsistencies in the metal reflections or tire rubber.

focus_areas: Integrity of the 5-lug nut pattern (symmetry and count)
Boundary sharpness between tire sidewall and rim lip
Consistency of reflections on the alloy spokes
Geometric plausibility of the spoke thickness and connection to the hub
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lug nuts; AI often generates incorrect counts (e.g., 4 or 6 instead of 5) or asymmetrical spacing. Verify that the reflections on the silver alloy follow a consistent light source direction. Check if the tire tread fades out naturally or if it looks pasted on.
